author: Ina Meyer, Cameron Owen Messmann, Roland Lachmayer
name: ct-based-porosity-analysis-of-316l-cucrzr-multi-material-specimens
notes:
This dataset was generated in the context of the parameter study presented in the paper: _Additive manufacturing of multi-material parts – Influence of process parameters on interface formation in in-plane 316L/CuCrZr laser powder bed fusion_

It contains the __VGSTUDIO MAX porosity analysis reports__ for all analyzed specimens. Porosity analysis was performed in VGSTUDIO MAX (version 2026.1). Each reconstructed volume was first registered to the nominal CAD geometry by best-fit alignment to provide a common coordinate system. Pores were then quantified within a __9.3 × 9.3 × 1.5 mm³__ region of interest centered on the coordinate origin of each sample, using the __VGEasyPore__ algorithm (Porosity/Inclusion Analysis module) in relative mode with a minimum contrast of 20% and a local area size of 10 voxels. The built-in noise reduction was set to "Low", and indications below a minimum size of 8 voxels were discarded to suppress image artifacts. The reports include the total porosity, pore statistics, indication tables, three-dimensional pore visualizations, and the complete analysis settings.

The dataset contains porosity analysis reports for the following specimen numbers (ordered by increasing volumetric energy density): 8, 16, 31, 1, 24, 26, 33, 15 (3×), 40, 10, 32, 25.

![ Representative CT-based porosity analysis of specimen 8.](https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/2fe1feea-710f-4b49-9678-c411a454e1a5/resource/2873b591-b79d-4e35-9a53-449eabf4624c/download/representive_specimen_8.png)
Representative CT-based porosity analysis of specimen 8.
